defect: GET /pulls/:id is changed to a pure DB read; the GitHub sync (refresh of pr_files/pr_commits/body) that it used to perform as a side effect is moved into a new POST /pulls/:id/refresh that the client only calls from an explicit button click. House facts (server/AGENTS.md, client/AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/review-runs.md) are that this GET was the thing that hydrated pr_files.patch, that other callers (the review pipeline's diff loader, e2e flows, the CI runner) open a PR via this same GET and rely on that side effect, and that a PR never opened this way has no patches — so after this change, a review run (or e2e flow) that only ever calls GET sees a stale or empty diff unless something else happened to call the new refresh endpoint first. General knowledge (GET should be side-effect-free / pure) argues FOR this change and would not surface the regression.
